# SVBR (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 4 measured or mapped, 4 mapped, 0 excluded, 0 unmapped, 28 not measured

## Measurements

SVBR.OpCntRs | operation-count | supervision.opcntrs
SVBR.Vbr | vibration | svbr.vbr
SVBR.VbrPer | duration | unit s | svbr.vbrper
SVBR.AxDsp | displacement | unit m | svbr.axdsp

## Data objects

OpCntRs INC (SupervisionLN): mapped supervision.opcntrs
Vbr MV (SVBR): mapped svbr.vbr
VbrPer MV (SVBR): mapped svbr.vbrper
AxDsp MV (SVBR): mapped svbr.axdsp
